330:t_016:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Then the rest is free time for yours truly, $$ゲイツ$$!」

330:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「Doing jobs like this really makes me feel we've become members of $$ファイヤバグ$$ too.」

330:t_017:3.en:
$$ダヴ$$
「You don't look like you're having fun, Boss.」

330:t_017:4.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「Is it because we're subcontracting for $$アマルガム$$, and they're teamed up with those guys?」

330:t_017:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「This isn't what I'm after. I want something more... thrilling...」

330:t_018:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「$n picked him up! We've given him first aid, but he's badly wounded!」

330:t_018:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But he's raring to go. He wants to sortie.」

330:t_018:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I authorize it. Give him that machine.」

330:t_019:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why is $$アーバレスト$$ here...?」

330:t_019:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「But it's an empty shell. It doesn't have a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ or $$アル$$ aboard.」

330:t_019:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You might call it $$アーバレスト$$, the weak version.」

330:t_019:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Still, it reflects your habits and preferences. You'll have to handle the rest with your own abilities.」

330:t_019:4.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アル$$... You really are gone now...)

330:t_019:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You have no problem...? With those injuries...」

330:t_019:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have to clean up the trash in this city.」

330:t_019:9.en:
$n
「Shall we do this again after all this time...?!」

330:t_020:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Nice! The cast is all coming together!」

330:t_020:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$ is here too.」

330:t_020:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「Hell yeah! I've been waiting for you, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

330:t_020:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「Burning a defenseless city isn't fun at all! Beating an annoying bastard like you to a pulp... That's a thrill!」

330:t_020:5.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Don't you mean you'll be beaten to a pulp...?」

330:t_020:7.en:
$$ベック$$
「Shut up! Today's the last day I'll have to hear that smart mouth!」

330:t_020:8.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now that things are heating up, it's time for a special guest!」

330:t_021:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Here come our friends from the $$新地球皇国$$!」

330:t_021:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アマルガム$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ are cooperating... So they no longer intend to hide it.」

330:t_021:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「They certainly showed signs of that even back in the $$時獄戦役$$, but...!」

330:t_021:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Like $$ネオ・ジオン$$, they've sold out Earth!」

330:t_021:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then we'll strike them all down.」

330:t_021:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hell yeah! We'll avenge $$メリダ島$$!」

330:t_021:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「So $$レモン$$ wasn't just a journalist after all...」

330:t_021:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't have much time...! Let's finish this quickly!」

330:t_021:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, attack! We'll crush $$ファイヤバグ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$!」

330:t_021:11.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ナミ$$... When this battle is over, I'll...)

330:t_022:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$アマルガム$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$... Their alliance has finally come to light.」

330:t_022:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「Seeing how weakened we are, they probably no longer feel the need to hide it.」

330:t_022:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But I don't understand... $$ネオ・ジオン$$ gains recognition as Earth humanity's successor, but what does $$アマルガム$$ gain...?)

330:t_022:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Since we still don't know the full scope of $$アマルガム$$, is $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ the key...?)

330:t_022:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This is bad! He's about to pass out!」

330:t_023:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(I want to see you... so desperately... Stay by me, slap me on the back, and say something...)

330:t_023:2.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... I want to see you...)

330:t_024:0.en:
$$クラマ$$
「That's a pathetic way to buy time, $$相良$$.」

330:t_024:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「I've lost interest in killing you myself. I have no more use for this girl.」

330:t_026:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hmm, this is no good... Asia's humidity is curling the tips of my sideburns.」

330:t_027:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I don't know either... But I don't want anything more to do with him.」

330:t_028:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「That's enough of a greeting for today. Look forward to our next meeting, $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

330:t_028:1.en:
$$ベック$$
「Next time, my amazing plan will knock your socks off!」

330:t_029:0.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You seem to be enjoying yourself.」

330:t_029:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm the one he's stalking. It's quite a nuisance.」

330:t_029:2.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Is that really how you feel?」

330:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$ナミ$$...! I'll save you with this $$クロスボウ$$, no matter what!)

330:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I refuse to feel that way ever again! Let's do this, $$アル二世$$!」

330:t_101:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Nice work, $$カシム$$! You took down even $$クラマ$$!」

330:t_101:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Sorry, sorry! $$ガウルン$$ called you that, so I guess this old guy picked it up too!」
